alt: 一位畫家獨自得意地欣賞自己的花卉畫，其他畫家在旁交流。
scene_prompt: At a community art gathering, one aloof amateur artist sits slightly apart proudly admiring their own framed flower painting with a self-satisfied raised chin, while several other artists in background warmly exchange and discuss each other’s different paintings. Their reserved posture dismisses the group. Show solitary self-admiration and self-importance, not loneliness or sadness; no text.
